cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Burmy
cards.description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.description: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.description: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

cards.name: Throh
cards.description: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.description: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Impidimp
cards.description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

cards.name: Morgrem
cards.description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl
cards.description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.description: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.description: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

cards.name: Castform
cards.description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.
